name: Submit
preconditions_and_action: Active authenticated student submits an allowed category and description with valid CSRF and submission key. Category maps to a configured team or central triage.
result_and_failure_behaviour: Create New case with accountable team, null assignee, student ownership, event and audit. Unknown routing configuration produces a safe error without losing a partially created record. Repeated submission key returns the existing result.

name: Triage and assign
preconditions_and_action: Scoped manager assigns an active eligible officer; a triage claimant may route an initial New case using their limited grant.
result_and_failure_behaviour: Record assignment and its reason atomically. Assignment alone leaves status New. Previous assignee loses access on the next request unless independently authorised.

name: Begin support
preconditions_and_action: Assigned officer or scoped manager starts an assigned New case.
result_and_failure_behaviour: New → In Progress, with event, audit and student-visible status change.

name: Request information
preconditions_and_action: Authorised staff write a student-visible question on an In Progress case.
result_and_failure_behaviour: Question and In Progress → Awaiting Student commit together. Generic notification enters the outbox. Notification failure does not roll back the case.

name: Student response
preconditions_and_action: Owner posts to an active case. On Awaiting Student, the system records the response.
result_and_failure_behaviour: Awaiting Student → In Progress atomically with the message. An extra message on New or In Progress leaves status unchanged. Student cannot perform arbitrary status updates.

name: Internal note
preconditions_and_action: Assigned officer or scoped manager records a factual staff note.
result_and_failure_behaviour: Append note and audit. A later correction appends a superseding note; the student-facing timeline exposes neither body nor note event.

name: Close
preconditions_and_action: Assigned officer or scoped manager closes an In Progress case with a student-visible resolution.
result_and_failure_behaviour: In Progress → Closed; save resolution, time, actor, event and notification. Awaiting Student must first return to In Progress with a reason. No automatic closure for silence in v1.

name: Reopen
preconditions_and_action: Student requests reopening through the published contact process. Scoped manager assesses it and records a reason.
result_and_failure_behaviour: Closed → In Progress with eligible assignee and retained history. Student cannot reopen directly; alternative is a new linked case.

name: Referral
preconditions_and_action: Assigned officer proposes purpose and minimal shared summary; source manager approves. Target manager receives only the proposal summary and necessary identity, with explicit referral access.
result_and_failure_behaviour: Acceptance creates a separate New target case and updates the referral in one transaction. Source case is unchanged. No target access to source notes. Rejection records a reason; repeat acceptance returns the existing target.

name: Staff departure
preconditions_and_action: Administrator deactivates account or revokes membership.
result_and_failure_behaviour: Invalidate relevant access and sessions; identify affected cases and alert managers. Preserve old attribution. Managers reassign cases; no silent deletion or abandoned ownership.

name: Archive and dispose
preconditions_and_action: Authorised policy process selects closed records, checks retention and holds.
result_and_failure_behaviour: Archive is a separate flag, not a fifth status. Routine views exclude archived cases; authorised archive access is audited. Disposal follows approved policy and backup lifecycle.
